entries.title: Grantchester on Masterpiece
entries.description: In the Cambridgeshire village of Grantchester in the 1950s, gruff, down-to-earth police inspector Geordie Keating's methodical approach to police work complements the intuitive techniques of local vicar Sidney Chambers, and later the Rev. Will Davenport. Geordie forms an unlikely partnership with both men of the cloth, and as partners they bring different insights into the crimes they start to unravel, forming true friendships as they work together. Village life in Grantchester proves to be much livelier than its sleepy appearance might suggest, with intrigue and gossip swirling in the background of Geordie's investigations.
entries.episodeDescription: Sidney is swept up in the civil rights movement after a pastor and his daughter arrive in Cambridge, and a murder sees racial tensions spike; Sidney struggles to remember a murdered woman's final words.

entries.title: MotorWeek
entries.description: "MotorWeek" is the first place to watch road tests of new vehicles. Regular segments include vehicle comparisons, fuel-efficient options and consumer-oriented news and features. Host, show creator and car expert John Davis travels America and the world, bringing viewers the latest automotive technologies and new car and truck models.
entries.episodeDescription: Testing the plug-in hybrid Mitsubishi Outlander; the Jeep Grand Cherokee.

entries.title: Growing a Greener World
entries.description: Environmentally friendly outdoor living is combined with traditional know-how in this series from American Public Television, which features people and places making a positive impact on the planet. In each episode, gardener Joe Lamp'l demonstrates a hands-on gardening project, and celebrity chef Nathan Lyon creates simple cuisine using fresh, local ingredients. Stories include a Seattle beekeeper who sets up a backyard hive, growing flowers without using chemicals, and a tour of a soil-testing lab.
entries.episodeDescription: Design tricks for gardening in small or oddly-shaped spaces.

entries.episodeDescription: Professor of international relations Rory Cormac discusses the Cold War.

entries.episodeDescription: Author Hanna Kozlowska talks about "U Up? An Intimate History of Online Dating."

entries.title: Asia Insight
entries.description: This 30-minute international newscast produced by Japan's national public broadcaster NHK looks at the realities of Asia today. From the diminishing natural coral along the coast of Boracay to the recruitment efforts by The Republic of Korea to find foreign workers to offset its labor shortage and aging population, the documentary series offers in-depth, behind-the-scenes analysis of news and public affairs issues affecting the continent. The series presents Asia as an evolving region open to change but one that is also home to traditional cultures.
entries.episodeDescription: An in-depth portrait of Asia today, covering its dynamism as a center of growth.

entries.episodeDescription: Rhiannon Giddens and Elvis Costello have a wide-ranging conversation about their music.

entries.title: State of Affairs with Steve Adubato
Sara's Weeknight Meals
entries.description: Chef, cookbook author and TV host Sara Moulton presents helpful hints for preparing quick and easy healthy meals at home. Episodes feature ideas for Sunday suppers, for one-pot meals, and for preparing flavor-packed meals using only five ingredients. Some recipes include pork tournedos with sage and prosciutto, steamed mussels in curried coconut broth, a fried-catfish bacon/lettuce/tomato sandwich, and a salad of grilled-salmon, arugula and grilled corn.
entries.episodeDescription: Creative takes on hot dogs and sausages, from American hot dogs to barbecued kielbasa; a flavorful Mauritian dish featuring sausage links, homemade roti and a spicy broth packed with island flavor.

entries.title: Lidia's Kitchen
entries.description: Daytime Emmy-winning chef Lidia Bastianich prepares simple, seasonal and economical dishes in this 26-episode series presented by WGBH. With tips and techniques collected over the years, Lidia prepares everything from apple cider-braised pork shoulder and salmon with mustard sauce to lentil country salad and Grandma Rosa's apple cake. Lidia's passion for cooking shines in every episode, where she teaches viewers how to draw on their own roots to create a sense of home in the kitchen.
entries.episodeDescription: Citrus and fennel salad; crispy smashed garlic rosemary potatoes; roast pork shoulder.

entries.title: Christopher Kimball's Milk Street Television
entries.description: Christopher Kimball demonstrates a bolder yet simpler way of preparing food.
entries.episodeDescription: Japanese cheesecake; sugared crème fraîche brioche buns; Chinese sponge cake inspired by the bakeries of Hong Kong.

entries.title: America's Test Kitchen
entries.description: Cooking tips, techniques and advice.
entries.episodeDescription: Banoffee pie; how to use air as an ingredient; browned butter shortbread.

entries.title: America's Test Kitchen
entries.description: Bridget Lancaster and Julia Collin Davison host a look inside America's Test Kitchen, which features a team of experts who check out the latest in cooking utensils, ingredients and cooking techniques. Whether they're trying to make the perfect roasted chicken with crispy skin or examining the science behind cooking with baking powder, team members try to offer unbiased and useful tips that can save viewers money, time and effort in their own kitchens. The basic team is frequently joined by other test cooks, as well as blind-taste judges.
entries.episodeDescription: Sous vide seared steaks; sous vide machines; soft poached eggs.

entries.title: Pati's Mexican Table
entries.description: Chef Pati Jinich introduces authentic Mexican flavors, colors and textures into American kitchens. Each episode features a single Mexican food, ranging from familiar ingredients like vanilla to mysterious grains used by the Aztecs. Season 8 explores simple and delectable dishes from both Mexico and the United States, including street food, a seafood feast, taco recipes, lobster recipes, and a breakfast based on Sinaloan classics.
entries.episodeDescription: The delicate ecosystem that sustains life in Coahuila; a traditional cabrito lunch; machacado con huevo; machaca egg scramble; rosas de strudel de manzana con hojaldre; apple strudel flower puffs.

entries.title: Dook Chase: A Chef's Journey
entries.description: A culinary tour showcasing the rich food traditions of New Orleans.
entries.episodeDescription: Executive Chef Gavin Goins, Chapter IV, offers modern takes on classic Creole breakfast and lunch dishes; pain perdu and chicken; pulled pork Benedict; egg frittata bites with spinach and ham.

entries.title: Remember Them with Steve Adubato and Jacqui Tricar
Secrets of the Dead
entries.description: Experts use modern forensic techniques to shed new light on historical mysteries such as the sinking of the Andrea Doria and the riddle of whether a weather or geological event of some kind might have triggered the Dark Ages.
entries.episodeDescription: Rising sea levels threaten tiny Tangier Island in the Chesapeake Bay off the coast of Virginia.

entries.title: Nature
entries.description: Consistently stunning documentaries transport viewers to far-flung locations ranging from the torrid African plains to the chilly splendors of icy Antarctica. The show's primary focus is on animals and ecosystems around the world. A comic book based on the show, meant to be used an as educational tool for kids, was briefly distributed to museums and schools at no cost in the mid-2000s.
entries.episodeDescription: Writer Joe Hutto raises wild turkeys from chicks in Florida.

entries.title: NOVA
entries.description: This long-running, award-winning documentary series focuses on science, its many applications, speculation, history and researchers. Inspired by the BBC documentary program "Horizons, " the U.S. series frequently features interviews with scientists directly involved in the topic at hand, and sometimes even boasts footage of a particular discovery.
entries.episodeDescription: Discovering the process behind the incredible variety of animal shapes and sizes.

entries.title: Kerry: Tides of Time
entries.description: The rich and multidimensional story of the Kerry landscape, from its earliest origins, deep in the geological past, right up to the present day.
entries.episodeDescription: The deep history, geology and human story of Kerry, from the first vertebrate life on a rocky shore to the struggle of early humans shaping a life in woods and valleys.

entries.title: Kerry: Tides of Time

entries.episodeDescription: The lives of badgers, red deer, hen harriers and puffins, from Skellig cliffs to forest dens.

entries.title: Les Stroud's Survivorman
entries.description: Outdoorsman and survival expert Les Stroud permits himself to be stranded for a week in a remote location with no equipment or supplies apart from his one-man camera rig, documenting his experience and providing insight into how to manage whatever hurdles the wilderness might throw at him.
entries.episodeDescription: Les is set adrift off the coast of Belize in a raft with no food and a bare minimum of equipment.
